test:
c = LFUCache(2)
c.put(1,1); c.put(2,2)
assert c.get(1) == 1          # freq: 1->2, 2->1
c.put(3,3)                    # evicts key 2
assert c.get(2) == -1
assert c.get(3) == 3
c.put(4,4)                    # 1 and 3 both freq 2 -> evict LRU among them (1)
assert c.get(1) == -1
assert c.get(3) == 3 and c.get(4) == 4
c0 = LFUCache(0)
c0.put(1,1)
assert c0.get(1) == -1
kind: offline visible-thinking candidate; synthetic wrapper, not a natural model final
